notes.title: Speedy Spears on the Steam Next Fest
notes.content:
[h2]The festival starts soon - everyone is invited to participate in the jousting tournament in the Speedy Spears demo![/h2]

[i]Add the game to your wishlist and share the news with your friends so that as many participants as possible come to the tournament - there will be enough silver for everyone! (gold for achievements will also be given)[/i]
